ITEM.PTXT: When the meter computer receives a shift position "R" signal from the engine control computer via the CAN communication system, it sounds the buzzer.

When the meter computer receives a key reminder warning buzzer sounding request signal from the Certification ECU via the CAN communication system with the power source mode OFF, it sounds the buzzer.

LIST1.TITLE: Smart Entry & Start System Warning Buzzer Operation

ITEM.PTXT: When the meter computer receives a warning buzzer sounding request signal from the Certification ECU and Main Body ECU via the CAN communication system, it sounds the buzzer.
For the operation of the warning mode display-linked buzzer, refer to "Multi-information Display Warning Display Mode".
When the meter computer receives a downshift reject signal from the engine control computer via the CAN communication system, it sounds the buzzer.

When the meter computer receives a driver door courtesy light switch ON signal from the Main Body ECU via the CAN communication system with the taillights ON and the power source mode OFF, it sounds the buzzer.

LIST1.TITLE: Driver Seat Belt Unfastened Warning Buzzer Operation

ITEM.PTXT: When the driver seat belt is unfastened (driver seat belt inner buckle switch ON), the Main Body ECU outputs a driver seat belt unfastened warning signal to the meter computer. While receiving this signal, the meter computer sounds the buzzer when the vehicle speed signal from the skid control computer reaches approximately 20km/h or more.

LIST1.TITLE: Front Passenger Seat Belt Unfastened Warning Buzzer Operation

ITEM.PTXT: When the meter computer receives an occupant detection sensor ON and front passenger seat belt inner buckle switch ON (front passenger seat belt not fastened) signal and the vehicle speed reaches approximately 20km/h or more, it sounds the buzzer in the same way as the driver seat belt unfastened warning buzzer.
As with the driver seat belt unfastened warning buzzer, the buzzer stops when the seat belt inner buckle switch turns OFF (seat belt fastened) or the power source mode is turned OFF.

LIST1.TITLE: Radar Cruise Low Speed Cancel Buzzer Operation

ITEM.PTXT: When the meter computer receives a low speed cancel buzzer sound request signal from the engine control computer via the CAN communication system, it sounds the buzzer.

LIST1.TITLE: Parking Brake Reminder Warning Buzzer Operation

ITEM.PTXT: When the parking brake signal (not released) is ON and the vehicle speed is 5km/h or more, the meter computer sounds the buzzer upon receiving signals from the main body ECU and skid control computer via the CAN communication system.

LIST1.TITLE: Electric Power Steering Warning Buzzer Operation

ITEM.PTXT: When the meter computer receives a signal indicating a power steering system malfunction from the power steering computer via the CAN communication system, it sounds the buzzer.
